ETCI 2021 Flood Detection Dataset
	



	
		
		Description
	

The ETCI 2021 Flood Detection Dataset is a comprehensive flood detection segmentation dataset that focuses on SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) images taken by the ESA Sentinel-1 satellite. This dataset provides pairs of VV (Vertical Transmit, Vertical Receive) and VH (Vertical Transmit, Horizontal Receive) polarization images, which have been processed by the Hybrid Pluggable Processing Pipeline (hyp3).
